WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM type_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.tradekind,
    tc.count,
    CAST(tc.count AS REAL) / CAST(ts.total AS REAL) as share
  FROM type_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.tradekind,
  s.count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg as share_minus_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE a.avg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.share > a.avg
